paper.title: Revisiting the Broken Symmetry Phase of Solid Hydrogen: A Neural Network Variational Monte Carlo Study
paper.authors: Shengdu Chai, Chen Lin, Xinyang Dong, Yuqiang Li, Wanli Ouyang, Lei Wang, X. C. Xie

results.system_description: 54 hydrogen atoms in a BCC lattice at r_s = 1.31, electrons and protons both quantum (proton mass M = 1836), fixed volume, periodic boundary conditions, no proton exchange
results.variant: DeepSolid-type electronic network with a nuclear network, 16 determinants
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the electron-proton neural-network wave function from an inference run after training (Supplemental Material, Sec. IV); the other rows of Table I are other methods.
results.notes: Energy per atom, Hartree. Table I and its caption are the same in v1, v2 and v3. The printed error is the standard error over saved records without autocorrelation; Supplemental Sec. IV gives 6.9e-6 Ha/atom after correction. Proton exchange neglected.
